items.title: At the Fed, Kevin Warsh Can’t Referee His Way Out of Inflation
items.author: Gabriel Chodorow-Reich
items.content: <article>The success of his chairmanship may rest on an issue that sits outside the traditional purview of monetary policy: the nation’s ongoing fiscal deficits.</article>

items.title: How Japan Minimized Deaths from a Major Earthquake
items.author: River Akira Davis, Hisako Ueno and Chang W. Lee
items.content: <article>After deadly tremors a decade ago, Kumamoto built earthquake-resistant buildings and even trained locals in search and rescue.</article>

items.title: In Upset, Andy Ogles Loses to a Republican Challenger in Tennessee
items.author: Emily Cochrane
items.content: <article>Mr. Ogles, a two-term congressman, had held off primary threats before, despite controversy. But on Thursday, Charlie Hatcher, a former state agriculture commissioner, delivered an upset.</article>

items.title: Fauci Is Far From the First Person to Plead the Fifth Before Congress
items.author: Mack Liederman
items.content: <article>The constitutional right against self-incrimination has been invoked on several occasions during high-profile — and contentious — hearings.</article>

items.title: Blackburn Wins Republican Nomination for Tennessee Governor
items.author: Emily Cochrane
items.content: <article>Senator Marsha Blackburn easily beat two Republican rivals and is now favored to become the state’s first female governor after the November elections.</article>

items.title: Trump Signs Executive Orders Targeting Birthright Citizenship and ‘Birth Tourism’
items.author: Maggie Haberman and Ann E. Marimow
items.content: <article>The orders come after the Supreme Court ruled June 30 that President Trump’s previous efforts to end birthright citizenship were unconstitutional.</article>

items.title: This A.I. Just Created Viruses Not Found in Nature
items.author: Carl Zimmer
items.content: <article>Scientists trained artificial intelligence on libraries of DNA and then asked the model to create recipes for viral genomes. Sixteen of them were viable, yielding new viruses.</article>

items.title: Some House Republicans Are Backing a Challenger in Cory Mills’s Re-election Bid
items.author: Patricia Mazzei
items.content: <article>Two Republican lawmakers have endorsed a primary opponent of Representative Cory Mills, who has been accused of assault and is under investigation by the House Ethics Committee.</article>

items.title: The Real Reason Behind Trump’s Yen Intervention
items.author: Eswar Prasad
items.content: <article>The U.S. is bolstering the yen, as it did with the Argentine peso. The reasons are not solely economic.</article>

items.title: After Trump Calls Canadians ‘Nasty,’ Mark Carney Says the Word Fits Trade Talks
items.author: Ian Austen
items.content: <article>Canada’s prime minister laughed off Trump’s description of Canada but suggested that trade talks between the two countries are acrimonious.</article>

items.title: Voter-Registration Error Could Cost Immigrants a Shot at a Green Card
items.author: Tracey Tully
items.content: <article>New Jersey improperly added as many as 6,600 noncitizens to its voter rolls. Those people could now be forced out of the country.</article>

items.title: Trump Issues Tariffs on Key Ingredient for Electronics and Solar Panels
items.author: Ana Swanson and Brad Plumer
items.content: <article>The administration will impose a minimum import price for polysilicon, a key component for semiconductors and solar panels, as well as tariffs for products made with the material.</article>

items.title: Senate Panel Votes to Hold Fauci in Contempt of Congress
items.author: Sheryl Gay Stolberg
items.content: <article>Dr. Anthony Fauci had refused to answer questions at a hearing last week, invoking the Fifth Amendment. Republicans argued he wasn’t entitled to that protection because he had a presidential pardon.</article>

items.title: Sydney Towle, Who Chronicled Her Cancer on TikTok, Dies at 26
items.author: Katherine Rosman
items.content: <article>For an audience that grew to more than a million followers, she challenged assumptions about how people with serious illnesses should look and live.</article>

items.title: Mitch McConnell Discharged From Rehabilitation Facility
items.author: Olivia Diaz
items.content: <article>The Kentucky Republican has been absent from Congress for nearly two months after a health episode. He said he would continue recovering from home.</article>

items.title: Trump Administration to Deregulate Head Start, Antipoverty Program Created Under R.F.K. Jr.’s Uncle
items.author: Coral Davenport
items.content: <article>While administration officials say the changes will save money by lifting onerous requirements, advocates fear the anti-poverty program will be gutted.</article>

items.title: Fled to America at 11. Stole at 18. Deported to Vietnam at 44.
items.author: Amy Qin and Albert Sun
items.content: <article>The Trump administration is sending back record numbers of Vietnamese, Laotians and Hmong. Many came to the United States as young war refugees and later committed crimes.</article>

items.title: Alcohol. Manliness. Flushable Wipes. Since When Are These ‘Scams’?
items.author: Nitsuh Abebe
items.content: <article>Americans have been taken with scams for years. Now, the word is being used for any system that ends with somebody profiting at their expense.</article>
